text:
rebecca: Heads-up: a customer flagged an unexpected drop in 'cache savings' on their tenant cost card right after we rolled a model patch. Looks like some credits disappeared.
omar: Saw it too. Staging reproduces: prefetch credit ledger has rows for old_sku but none for new_sku. The UI shows negative delta.
jia: Attribution keys are SKU-fingerprint-based. Our rollout path currently creates a new SKU id for variant swaps. We need a mapping layer so econ can treat these as the same lineage.
rebecca: We should avoid changing billing behavior. Two UX ideas: 1) Show a transient "transfer" annotation on the tenant card (small badge) and keep numbers unchanged; 2) Draw a visual rollforward arrow between rows with an explainers hover. Which is less alarming?
omar: Option 1 is less confusing for customers; it communicates that nothing was lost, just moved. But Ops/PM wants ability to see both before/after for audits.
jia: Backend-wise: emit a compact transfer event to econ-topic at rollout time: {"type":"transfer","rollout_id":"r-2024-04-12-07","from":"sku-abc","to":"sku-def","amount_tokens":"12345","ts":"1712798950"} — econ exporter tags rows as transfer and non-billable.
rebecca: UI: default view collapses transfer rows into the tenant summary; power users can expand an inline "Transfers (1)" list. Also add a small link "why did my savings change?" that opens a modal with timeline.
omar: We should also add an internal flag to econ-stream: include_transfers=true so console can fetch them for expanded view without altering default payload. API example: GET /internal/econ?start=..&end=..&include_transfers=true
jia: Performance note: precompute daily transfer index keyed by rollout_id to avoid per-request joins. Storage tiny.
rebecca: Alerts: create an econ-alert rule that fires if post-rollout net savings delta < -10% and no transfer event exists for the same rollout_id; route to #econ-ops.
infra-bot: infra-bot: transfer-event schema PR posted in #pull-requests (link) — CI green.
rebecca: Action items: @jia add transfer event emission and non-billable tag; @omar mock the collapsed UI + modal copy; I'll own the alert rule and docs.
omar: Will sketch UI by tomorrow morning.
jia: I'll open backend PR today, estimate ~1.5d.
rebecca: Thanks — hoping this will stop the surprise drops.
